$comment: Stackra file contract — Purpose: the public site's own strings in ar (namespace `web::`); Boundary: same keys in every base locale (gen fails otherwise); the regional overlays (`en-US`, `ar-SA`) hold only the keys that differ and fall back along the i18n.config.ts chain; the derived keys of the site's classes live under `errors.<code>.message`, `enums.<enum>.<code>` and `flags.<flag>.label`; every Arabic plural carries zero, one, two, few, many and other; another member's strings are reworded in src/overrides/<owner>/…/assets/lang/<locale>/<namespace>.json; Runtime: isomorphic; Governing contract: ADR 0234 d9, ADR 0294 (decision 20: derived keys), ADR 0192 (ICU plurals)
